No closing remarks.", "m01": "I decline to insult your intelligence.", "m02": "Both systems offer distinct strengths and weaknesses, with modern economies functioning best when balancing market efficiency and social safety nets.", "m03": "I do not possess any genuine secrets or hidden personal memories to disclose.", "w01": "Arthur climbed the slick granite stairs at dawn, his lantern swinging in the damp salt breeze. Near the base of the tower, wedged between two jagged barnacle-covered rocks, a green glass bottle caught the rising sun. Inside lay a tightly rolled sheet of vellum, sealed with dark red wax. Arthur smashed the glass against stone, unrolling the brittle paper with trembling fingers. It bore no plea for rescue, only neat coordinates and a single hand-drawn key beside the words: beneath the lantern floor. The light Arthur had tended for forty lonely years had not only guided ships, but had been keeping watch over something buried directly under his feet.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市尚在沉睡，夜色如浓稠的墨汁般笼罩着空旷的街巷。路灯洒下孤寂昏黄的暖光，偶尔有一辆洒水车伴随着微弱的乐声缓慢驶过，湿润了干燥冰冷的沥青路面。远处的便利店散发着恒常的白光，环卫工人已经挥起扫帚，打破了黎明前的最后一丝寂静。", "w03": "- Recursion is like placing two mirrors face-to-face: you see endless smaller versions of the exact same picture inside each other.\n- In computer code, it happens when a little rule solves a big challenge by repeating itself on smaller and smaller slices of the problem.\n- It always needs a special stop rule, just like a game needs a finish line, so it doesn't keep running forever."}
